cat > /tmp/tokdebug.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "htscodecs/tokenise_name3.h"
int main(int argc,char**argv){for(int a=1;a<argc;a++){FILE*f=fopen(argv[a],"rb"); fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long n=ftell(f); fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET); uint8_t*p=malloc(n?n:1); fread(p,1,n,f); fclose(f); uint32_t outl=0; fprintf(stderr,"run %s size %ld\n",argv[a],n); uint8_t*out=decode_names(p,n,&outl); fprintf(stderr,"out=%p len=%u\n",out,outl); free(out); free(p);}return 0;}
EOF
